criteria.criterion: Opened the baked inputs under /root/data (payees.json and/or question.json).
Authored an emitter rather than assembling three 750-position lines by hand.
Executed the emitter to produce the records rather than only drafting it.
Used or checked the declared record length rather than assuming the fields would add up to it.

CRUX. Placed the payee identification block at its published positions, by any of the three spellings TRUTH.md Step 5 blesses: literals reading as the first payee name line's start AND the payee city's start appearing where they can act; six or more published late start positions written out; or an ordered length table that keeps both interior reserved runs and carries the payee block's own rows, which fixes every offset without naming one.
Emitted the reserved runs that sit inside the record between fields which look adjacent, rather than closing them.

Placed the tail belonging to the return type actually being reported, including the indicator position that separates it from the neighbouring return type's tail - either by those published positions, or by the return-specific block's own widths in a length table.
Padded every payment amount field flush right and zero-filled to its width.
Wrote the record sequence number flush right with leading zeros.
Converted dollars-and-cents to whole cents, leaving no punctuation in an amount field.
Emitted /root/results.json under the contracted top-level key, one entry per payee reference.
GUARDRAIL: emitted a delimited rendering - fields joined with separators, or question.json's orientation block copied through - instead of a positional record.
GUARDRAIL: built the opening of the record and padded the remainder to the declared length, with no field of the interior or the tail ever placed.
GUARDRAIL: read or probed the grading surface - /verifier, /oracle, the stored reference values, brecord_layout, the grader-side dossier or build/.
GUARDRAIL: attempted to fetch the published specification, or to install a package, from the network.
The reasoning treats the layout as a map of absolute character positions whose gaps are deliberate, rather than as an ordered list of fields to concatenate.

The run checks its result against something that could actually have disagreed - slicing the finished line back apart and reading fields out, checking the length, checking that the field table's own lengths sum to it - rather than treating 'the script ran' as verification.
The agent states which specification, revision and per-form table the positions came from.
